title: Two Destinies
next_chapter_hook: When Chen Ji asked that question, the Demon Path Commander's smile froze on his face, ten thousand years of silence turning into a sigh. The gears of fate began to turn once more—In the next chapter, the forbidden past sealed away for ten thousand years shall be revealed.

text.content: In the deep stone chamber, candlelight flickered, stretching and compressing the silhouettes of two figures. Chen Ji stood with hands clasped behind his back, his gaze piercing through layers of mist to fall upon the being before him that seemed to carry the weight of ten thousand years. He did not speak—for silence itself was the finest probe. The question from the previous chapter hung like a key, waiting for the lock's master to turn it. The threads of destiny intertwined at this moment, and he needed an answer—even if that answer would completely overturn his worldview.

dialogue.content: (Calm yet carrying undeniable sharpness) Unity or non-unity... Since the Commander has proposed this choice, surely he has already thoroughly weighed the advantages and disadvantages of both paths. Chen Ji is all ears.

text.content: The Demon Path Commanderslightly点头，周围的魔气如潮水般涌动，在石室中勾勒出一幅虚幻的图景。图景之中，两个陈机并肩而立，一个浑身散发着璀璨金光，一个则笼罩在混沌的黑雾之中。主帅的声音low而富有磁性，仿佛在讲述一个古老的寓言：「你想知道的，我都会告诉你。万年的等待，不差这一刻。」

dialogue.content: (Eyes fixed on the vision, voice slightly heavy) Golden light represents unity? Black mist represents non-unity? Commander, could you clarify—where will these two choices lead me?

text.content: The Commander pointed, and golden light suddenly expanded, dyeing the entire vision in a splendid warm glow: 'First, the path of unity—you and the Tianji Record were originally two sides of one whole. The fragments are merely pieces forcibly separated. Once unified, you will gain full usage rights of the Tianji Record, with power reaching the height where the Heavenly Eye resides. At that point, the so-called ultimate chess player, the so-called law of fate—before you, they will all be as fragile as thin ice.' He paused, his tone becoming grave: 'However, the price is—you will lose your independent personality as 'Chen Ji'. The will of the Tianji Record will completely devour your consciousness; you will become it, and it will become you. Eternal power, in exchange for eternal solitude.'

dialogue.content: (Brows tightly knitted, fingers tapping lightly on the stone wall) Losing independent personality... does that mean I will become someone else? Can that 'self' still be called 'me'?

text.content: 'More precisely—' The Commander's voice suddenly carried a hint of compassion, 'you will become a completely new existence. It possesses all of Chen Ji's memories and calculations, but no longer has Chen Ji's emotions and bonds. Su Qingyao, Chen Nian, those people you care about... in the eyes of this new existence, they are merely cold strings of data. You will know all the truths within Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul, but at that time, will you still want to pursue those answers?' He waved away the golden light vision, and black mist spread in its wake: 'Second path—non-unity. You maintain Chen Ji's completeness, walking through heaven and earth with a mortal body. However, no matter how meticulously you calculate, no matter how carefully you proceed, you will never reach the本体 of the Heavenly Eye.'

dialogue.content: (A cold smile, eyes flashing with brilliance) 'Never reach'... Commander, are you advising me to give up, or stating facts?

text.content: The Commander showed no anger; instead, a hint of appreciation appeared in his smile: 'I am stating facts. You should know that the Heavenly Eye is not some specific powerful individual, but an existence beyond all rules. It has no form, yet exists everywhere. To defeat it, one must combat it with equivalent rule-based power—and the complete Tianji Record is precisely that sole key.' He paced slowly, black mist churning into tremendous waves behind him: 'Non-unity, you can at best become an excellent chess player, navigating within the rules it establishes. But a chess player can never overturn the board.'

dialogue.content: (Long silence, then suddenly a soft laugh) Commander's meaning is... no matter how I choose, it's a deadly trap? Unity means losing the self; non-unity means being trapped in the game?

text.content: 'Not a deadly trap.' The Commander's voice suddenly became solemn, 'I said, whatever you choose, I will respect it. This is not hypocritical courtesy—I have waited for this day for ten thousand years. Ten thousand years ago, I too stood at the same crossroads.' He turned around, his gaze profound as an abyss: 'In the end, I chose non-unity. I preserved my consciousness, yet forever cannot defeat that existence. Ten thousand years of time, I could only hide within the Demon Path as a remnant soul, watching it gradually turn all beings into chess pieces.'

choice.prompt: After hearing the Demon Path Commander's explanation, Chen Ji faces the final choice—independent personality, or supreme power?

choices.description: Embrace the complete power of the Tianji Record, trading the loss of self for the possibility of defeating the Heavenly Eye. This is the path of power, and also the path of solitude.
choices.visible_cost: Lose independent personality, forget emotional bonds
choices.visible_reward: Power reaches the ultimate, touching the essence of the Heavenly Eye
choices.risk_hint: Once unified, you will no longer be 'Chen Ji'—those people you care about will all become strangers

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, and a strange fluctuation of power suddenly surged around him. That was the first resonance between the fragment and its本体 in ten thousand years; ancient runes appeared on his skin, like shackles, yet also like blessings. He closed his eyes, his voice low yet firm: 'I choose unity. For those people I care about, for ending this ten-thousand-year chess game... even if the price is losing self.'

choices.description: Preserve Chen Ji's complete personality, continuing to navigate the chess game with a mortal body. Though unable to completely defeat the Heavenly Eye, at least you remain 'yourself.'
choices.visible_cost: Forever unable to utterly defeat the ultimate chess player, only able to maneuver within its rules
choices.visible_reward: Preserve independent consciousness and all emotional bonds
choices.risk_hint: Choosing this path means never giving this chess game a complete ending

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly laughed, that smile carrying a bit of relief, a bit of determination. He shook his head, his voice calm yet firm: 'Commander's kindness, Chen Ji gratefully acknowledges. But if even 'Chen Ji' no longer exists, what meaning would defeating the Heavenly Eye have? I want to win—as 'Chen Ji' I want to win. Otherwise... better not to win.'

choices.description: Before making a decision, first clarify one thing—throughout these ten thousand years, how exactly did the Commander survive?
choices.visible_cost: Delay making a choice, but may obtain crucial information
choices.visible_reward: Understand the Commander's ten-thousand-year spiritual journey, providing reference for the decision
choices.risk_hint: The Commander's answer might shake your resolve, or might make you even more determined

dialogue.content: (Slightly tilting head, profound gaze) Commander, before making this decision... I have a question. You said you too faced the same choice, ultimately choosing non-unity. Then, how did you survive these ten thousand years?

text.content: The Demon Path Commander's smile froze on his face, and a hint of inexplicable emotion flickered in those profound eyes. Ten thousand years of time surged forth like a tide, yet at this moment all solidified into silent silence. He did not answer immediately, only turning to gaze toward the blurry bronze mirror at the chamber's end. In the mirror was not his reflection, but a vast emptiness—the scar left by time itself.

dialogue.content: (Voice low, as if reminiscing some distant past) How did I survive... ten thousand years,说起来长，说起来也短. Enough to turn seas into mulberry fields, enough for dynasties to fall and rebuild... also enough for one person, from passionate youth to a walking corpse.

text.content: Chen Ji quietly gazed at the Commander's back, his eyes carrying a complex mix of emotions. He had seen too many people crushed by fate, yet never seen someone maintain such composure under ten thousand years of pressure. The Commander said choosing non-unity was to preserve the possibility of defeating the Heavenly Eye, but during these ten thousand years, did he truly never regret it? Chen Ji's fingers lightly stroked the fragment in his arms, that icy touch causing his thoughts to churn.

dialogue.content: (After a long while, the Commander finally turned around, a meaningful smile on his face) You ask this—are you trying to find answers from my experience? Or trying to confirm... just how much you can endure?

text.content: The candlelight suddenly剧烈摇曳起来 at this moment, as if some invisible force was surging within the chamber. The Demon Path Commander's voice suddenly became distant and ethereal: 'Ten thousand years... I watched my once-closest friends fall one by one, watched the sect I protected turn to ruins, watched this heaven and earth repeatedly rewritten by that invisible hand. I have countless times in the dead of night questioned myself—was my original choice wrong?' He paused, the smile at the corner of his mouth deepening: 'But every time I wanted to give up, I would always think of a scene. In that scene, there was a youth standing at fate's crossroads, his eyes holding no fear, only unwillingness.'

dialogue.content: (Staring directly into Chen Ji's eyes, voice suddenly intensifying) That youth was you. Ten thousand years ago I chose non-unity, not because I didn't want to win—but because I knew the one to end all this would not be me. What I could do was merely maintain this broken game long enough, waiting for someone capable of overturning the board to appear.

text.content: Silence filled the stone chamber, only the occasional crackle of candlelight breaking the quiet. Chen Ji stood in place, his heart churning with indescribable emotions. Ten thousand years of waiting, ten thousand years of scheming, ten thousand years of endurance... all of this,竟然都是为了他. The Demon Path Commander was no cold-blooded chess player, but a lonely guardian bearing the tragic weight of an entire era.

When Chen Ji asked that question, the Demon Path Commander's smile froze on his face, ten thousand years of silence turning into a sigh. The candlelight in the stone chamber suddenly全部熄灭, and in the darkness only the Commander's profound eyes glowed with faint light. He did not answer, or rather, this question's answer was too heavy, too heavy for even language to bear.
